summary: Jenkinsfile.promote meets P2's outcome and V15. It retags the promoted commit's seven prd pins, then fast-forwards prd (creating it on the first run), then pushes release-<build number>. All refusals run before the registry is touched, and it holds the GitHub credential only. One advisory: a failed release-tag push after prd moved cannot be finished by a re-run.

findings.summary: After prd moves, a failed release-<m> push is refused on re-run ('nothing to promote'), so the job never writes that promotion's D48 tag
